biography.value:
Mist dragons live near waterfalls and misty coasts. They are solitary and thoughtful, and they spend years in mist form, drifting and dreaming. They become dangerous only when disturbed.

Unofficial 5e conversion of a dragon from an earlier edition of the game, for the Legacy Dragons module.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .Cmxr35JswgYS173M]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes three attacks: one with its [[/item .IncqZFh0EFhRtBHv]]{bite} and two with its [[/item .fXaECWiMXKKXizpe]]{claws}.
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

activation.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw.

description.value:
Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=1a3MiFyG165vFLhh]] of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=1a3MiFyG165vFLhh]].

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.
description.chat: Each creature of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=1a3MiFyG165vFLhh]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effects.name: Frightful Presence
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success. If your saving throw is successful or the effect ends for you, you are immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

description.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} slams its long tail against its foe!

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} beats its wings. Each creature within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=fTLBsulRXngKvvQc]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can then fly up to half its flying speed.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a cloud of scalding mist in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=llbevoltiPugX4ig]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save activity=llbevoltiPugX4ig]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=llbevoltiPugX4ig]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.

As an action, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can turn into a cloud of mist or back. In mist form it has a flying speed of 30 feet, can hover, can't attack, and has resistance to nonmagical damage.

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • Mist fills a 30-foot sphere; the area is heavily obscured.
  • Scalding steam rises from the water: each creature in a 20-foot square must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire damage.
  • The dragon teleports to a space in mist within 60 feet.
